cards.text: Last week we sold {sales_week}. I want {sales_target} this week. Cash in hand means the bills stop being scary, and what's spare, I can put towards people who need it.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Let's sell {sales_target} this week. We did {sales_week} last week, so it's a push, not a miracle. Money's how I sleep. Past that, it's money for someone else's rent.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: Sales were {sales_week} last week. Make it {sales_target}. A fat week and I stop watching the post for bills, and I can say yes to a favour without doing sums first.
